items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Noble Sissle came here in 1935... And a boy named Banks, singer. And they played -- they played here

ctx.x: Sarter's Park, that's right. That was in 1935, when they came, you see. When they came -- Noble Sissle came here in 1935, so we -- we opened the Club in 1934, and went through the holidays into 1935.
We would open in September and close in April.
